text: In a dream, a dream, a vision came to you 50 virgins drinking milk with nothing else to do Reclining on an island beach, pointing out the sea Where smoke is rising from a ship and the rest is hard to see I'm a jolly capitaine with nothing much to do I've eaten all the chicken cakes, I've drunk all the stew I've smoked a hash, I've drunk the wine, I've mourned the boyish crew
